status: User approved the exact process-lifetime Cython startup retention diagnostic on 2026-10-03.
root_cause: Cython 3.2.9 defaults generate_cleanup_code to False. Generated module globals retain constants, functions, types and references to imported Python modules until process exit. The compiler documents that forced global/type cleanup has no safe ordering guarantee, so packaging retains the normal default.

control.scope: Cython-only extension and CPython, without Qore, gRPC or Abseil. Class construction/methods, positive/negative arguments, coroutine calls and teardown after 1 and 10000 lifetimes.

requested_scope: Only process-lifetime startup objects rooted by generated Cython extension globals and their imported-module references. CPython Unicode retention is covered by the earlier exception. No invalid memory access or growing per-operation allocation is covered. Native gRPC allocations, other warnings and diagnostic sites remain separate.

approval.scope: Only process-lifetime startup objects rooted by generated Cython extension globals and their imported-module references. CPython Unicode retention is covered by the earlier exception. No invalid memory access or growing per-operation allocation is covered. Native gRPC allocations, other warnings and diagnostic sites remain separate.
